correctness.rationale: Re-executed output/artifacts/verify_phi2.py: ALL CHECKS PASSED. Verified two-sided inverse Psi(a)=d,Psi(b)=a,Psi(c)=bD,Psi(d)=c on all 8 oriented edges, so Phi2 is an automorphism. Verified Phi2(<a,c>)=<b,d> and Phi2(<b,d>)=<a,c> via positive words with generation both ways (c=(ca)a^-1, d=(db)b^-1), so phi2 permutes a proper free-factor system with phi2^2 fixing each factor: reducible, not fully irreducible. Verified commutator orbit acAC->bdBD->caCA->dbDB->acAC with only stated length-2 cancellations, each representative cyclically reduced and nontrivial, giving a periodic conjugacy class of period dividing 4: toroidal, not atoroidal. M^2 block-diagonal corroborates swap. All proof by hand-checkable word identities, not experimental evidence.
